# uzc_vpc_restart (Resource)

Restarts a UzCloud VPC's network (GET /vpcs/{slug}/restart) once on create and again whenever `triggers` changes. There is nothing to read back or clean up, so this resource exists purely to fire the restart action at a time the caller controls.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Restarts the VPC's network once on create, and again any time a value in
# `triggers` changes (this is the null_resource / triggers pattern, since a
# restart is an action rather than a piece of declarative state).
resource "uzc_vpc_restart" "example" {
  vpc = uzc_vpc.example.slug

  triggers = {
    cidr = uzc_vpc.example.cidr
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc` (String) Slug of the uzc_vpc to restart. Changing this forces a new restart.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary key/value pairs. Changing any value forces the VPC to be restarted again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) An opaque identifier, unrelated to any UzCloud object.
